title: Frontend Developer
description:
**Frontend Developer | Geospatial Industry | Remote in Germany | 2 stage process | C1+ English & German | €65-€75k**

I am working with a super exciting business who are building a 1 of 1 product which is going to impact the majority of German citizens in the very near future. This is a very sizeable project that has never been done before.

You will join a team of 20 in varying skill sets sot continue to take this project to the next level.

If you have experience within 2D or 3D & the Geospatial space this could be very interesting to you.

**Skills:**

*   Several years in a Frontend development roles
*   Experience within the Geospatial industry
*   Exposure to 2D and 3D data
*   React
*   TypeScript
*   Rest APIs
*   Potree - ideally
*   Material UI
*   Clean Architecture
*   PostgreSQL
*   GIS technologies or something similar

**Information:**

*   Remote in Germany - 2-3 visits per quarter
*   Fluent German - C1 and above
*   Fluent English
*   2 stage remote interview process
*   Salary - €65,000-€75,000 per annum

If this sounds interesting and you would like to know more, please apply and or reach out to me on LinkedIn and we can set up a call!

title: Front-End Developer Internship: Crafting the Urban Interface
description:
**FlavorScale is seeking a Front-End Developer Intern to lead the visual and interactive evolution of our platform. In a world of cluttered apps, we are building something that feels like the future of the city. You aren’t just "slicing designs"; you are engineering the bridge between our complex data and the user's thumb.  
  
****Most internships give you a "UI kit" and tell you to stay in the lines—we’re giving you the canvas. You will work directly with the CTO and CEO to ship a world-class interface that defines our brand as we head toward the 2026 Q3 funding round.  
  
**Who You Are  
  

*   Background: Currently studying Computer Science, Web Development, Interaction Design, or a related field.
*   The Pixel Perfectionist: You have a physical reaction to misaligned elements. You believe that a 404 page is an opportunity for branding and that micro-interactions are what make an app feel "premium."
*   The Bridge: You speak both "Design" and "Code." You can look at a Figma prototype and know exactly how to translate those shadows, blurs, and transitions into performant CSS/JS.
*   User-Obsessed: You don't just build for the sake of code; you build for the person standing on a rainy street in Amsterdam trying to find the perfect dinner spot.
*   Vibe: You are creative, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented. You’re likely the person who inspects the source code of every cool website you visit.  
      
    

Your Daily Mission  
  

*   UI/UX Implementation: Turn high-fidelity Figma designs into responsive, lightning-fast components using modern frameworks.
*   State Management: Ensure that the user experience is fluid, handling complex data flows without the user ever seeing a "loading" spinner if you can help it.
*   Performance Optimization: Audit our front-end to ensure we are hitting "Green" on all web vitals. In the city, every millisecond of load time matters.
*   Prototyping: Rapidly build and test new interaction patterns to see how users respond to different ways of "discovering" food culture.
*   The Style Guide: Help us maintain and expand the FlavorScale Design System, ensuring our code is as modular and scalable as our vision.  
      
    

The Opportunity  
  
This is a work-based internship that offers a **Masterclass in Product Engineering**. While we cannot promise permanent positions—as our key hires depend on 2026/2027 investment cycles—this is our **Frontend Talent Pipeline**. Successful interns who demonstrate an "owner" mindset and an eye for world-class UI will be top-of-mind for Lead Frontend roles as we scale.  
  
Specific Requirements  
  

*   Location: Remote-First (Netherlands residency preferred for periodic design sprints in Amsterdam).
*   Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React (or similar frameworks like Vue/Next.js). Mastery of modern CSS (Tailwind, Styled Components).
*   Status: This must be a formal internship as part of your degree.
*   Language: Fluent in English.
*   Portfolio: You have a GitHub or a portfolio site that shows you can build things that look and feel modern.
companyIndustry: Hospitality, Marketing Services, and Advertising Services
